description: Revoke people's shares of a website or a skill, by email. Each address's link stops working at once, and revoking is permanent: sharing again with the same address mails a new link. This cannot be undone, so confirm the addresses with the user first. An address with no share is reported, not refused. Sharing does not change who else can reach it. Only a website or a skill can be shared by email; an app or an agent is refused. Requires connecting a Valet account.

emails.description: Required. The email addresses whose shares to revoke, at most 10 at a time.

kind.description: The kind you mean. Omit to act on whatever the name holds; give it to have a name holding another kind refused.

name.description: Required. The website's or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the website or skill belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: unshare_service
title: Revoke website or skill shares
